subject: Cascade platform: production latency spike and throughput drop
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@optix.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: support@optix.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production alert: sudden latency spike & 503s (Platinum)

Neha —

We started seeing a major change in behavior on Cascade around 15:40 PT: p95 latency jumped from ~120ms to 1.2s, overall throughput dropped ~40%, and about 3% of requests are returning 503s. This affects our real-time routing for customer-facing sessions (Platinum tier).

We've tried restarting our local pool, but the issue persists. We've captured a short sample of logs and a telemetry snapshot attached (optix_incident_log_0428.txt, snapshot attached in case it helps). Can Redwood confirm whether this is a known degradation on your side or if you see correlated errors/queueing?

We're ready to jump on a call — this is impacting active sessions for 03:00–04:00 UTC window. Please advise immediate next steps.

—Carlos
Carlos Mendez
Head of Ops, Optix AI
carlos@optix.ai

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@optix.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production alert: sudden latency spike & 503s (Platinum)

Carlos —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the logs. We're escalating to an internal war-room now and will stand up an executive bridge if needed. Initial checklist:
- Karthik (SRE) is taking commander for the bridge and will lead triage.
- We'll confirm whether this aligns with any recent rollout or kernel/quantization changes.
- Sharing an initial telemetry snapshot we pulled (initial_telemetry_snapshot.png).

Proposed immediate steps:
1) Internal triage in 10 minutes (I've looped Karthik).
2) If we confirm production impact, we will open an exec bridge (9:30 PT) and provide a customer-facing update within 45 minutes.

We have attached the logs you sent and an internal capture. Can you confirm whether you see client-side throttles or any proxies that could be returning 503s? Also, please keep the session IDs for any impacted transactions handy.

I'll be the primary Redwood contact for Optix on this.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production alert: sudden latency spike & 503s (Platinum)

Neha / Marissa —

On it. I'm opening a PagerDuty incident and pulling node-level telemetry now. Early indicators: transient queue depth increase on the gpt-infer-3 pool and a small spike in kernel OOM retry rates on two hosts. Nothing yet to indicate a rollout-triggered regression, but kernel selection logs are noisy — could be related to recent quantization profile we've A/B'd in eu-west.

PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-78342
Runbook: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDEfGHijkLMnopqRSTuvWxY/edit

I'm starting the war-room at 16:45 PT. Commander: me. Scribe: Marissa. Ops tasks:
- Isolate affected GPU pool (karthik)
- If necessary, fail traffic to a fallback model variant (neha coordinate with customer)
- Capture traffic snapshots and token-level error traces

Will update in the bridge and then we can produce a customer-facing note.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal SRE — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec: Cascade impact — war-room summary & stakeholder comms (9:30 PT bridge)

Team —

Summary: Optix is experiencing p95 latency increases to ~1.2s, throughput ~40% down, error rate ~3% (503). Karthik reports queue depth and kernel OOM retries on gpt-infer-3 hosts. War-room convened 16:45 PT 4/28; we've run isolation and shadowed fallback routing.

Agenda for 9:30 PT Exec Bridge:
- Quick recap (3m) — Karthik
- Impact & customer exposure (3m) — Neha
- Mitigation options & ETA (5m) — Engineering lead
- Exec asks & external comms approval (4m)

Roles:
- Incident Commander: Karthik Iyer
- Customer Liaison: Neha Kapoor (I'll send the external update)
- Scribe/Telemetry: Marissa Cole
- Exec Sponsor: Laura Bennett

Proposed mitigations (pre-approval):
- Fail traffic for Platinum sessions to fallback model variant (10–15% quality delta) — reduces queue pressure.
- Temporarily increase pool capacity (burst off our reserved buffer) — if fallback alone insufficient.
- Roll back recent quantization A/B on affected hosts (if we confirm correlation).

Customer-facing update (draft):
"Optix — we're actively triaging a performance regression affecting a small portion of traffic. Our SREs have isolated the affected GPU pool and are implementing failover to a fallback model variant now. We expect a customer-visible improvement within 45 minutes and will follow up with a post-mortem within 72 hours"

Attachments: warroom_agenda_0429.pdf (internal), initial_telemetry_snapshot.png, optix_incident_log_0428.txt

Please be on the bridge at 9:30 PT. If you have immediate objections to the fallback routing plan, flag them now.

-Neha

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@optix.ai>
Cc: Optix SRE Team <sre@optix.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Cascade performance update — mitigation in progress & next customer update in 45m

Carlos —

Quick update from the war-room:
- We implemented failover to the fallback model variant for affected Platinum sessions at 08:50 PT. Early telemetry shows p95 down to ~320ms for routed sessions; overall error rate trending from 3% -> 0.8%.
- We've also temporarily increased capacity by spinning up two warm instances from our reserved burst pool; this reduced queue depth on the gpt-infer-3 pool.
- Engineering is continuing to validate kernel selection logs; rollback of the quantization A/B is on standby if we confirm correlation.

Next steps / ask from Optix: please confirm whether you want us to keep fallback routing in place for the next 2 hours while we complete validation, or revert traffic to the primary model once your test cohort looks healthy. We'll send another status update in 45 minutes with concrete numbers and any changes to the mitigation plan.

Attachments: optix_incident_log_0428.txt (original from Optix), initial_telemetry_snapshot.png

We appreciate the patience — we'll get this stabilized and follow up with a detailed incident timeline and root cause analysis within 72 hours.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
